annotations.title: Move a held order to a provider that ships there

description:
Move an order that is held because its fulfillment provider cannot deliver to the address (get_order_details shows `hold_details.code` `destination_unsupported`) to the same design on a provider that ships there. Pass the product_uuid from `hold_details.suggested_reroute.product_uuid`; use a different product only if the user names it. The platform creates the order in the store that sells that product, sends it there as a draft, and closes the held original; the storefront link and tracking move with it. Allowed only when the target product's store is connected to the SAME storefront the order came from (an order entered by hand, with no storefront link, may move to any store). When `suggested_reroute` is null no move is allowed: do not call this, tell the user to cancel the order and refund the customer on their storefront. Refusals (HTTP 409) carry a merchant-readable `message`; relay it: not_destination_held, destination_unsupported, product_not_in_connected_store, reroute_variants_missing, recipient_unavailable, reroute_channel_mismatch. Ask the user before calling: it changes which provider prints and charges for the order.

[#d8b77d]

order_uuid.description: The held order uuid (from list_my_orders / get_order_details).

product_uuid.description: The product to fulfill the order with: hold_details.suggested_reroute.product_uuid, unless the user names another product with the same design.
